description: This Java class 'PdfService' provides functionality for generating PDF documents, including printing client lists and contracts, using the iText PDF library within a Spring application. It interacts with entity classes such as Client, Company, and Contract, and utilizes a repository for company data.

classes.name: PdfService
classes.description: A Spring service class responsible for generating PDF documents for clients and contracts using the iText library.

methods.name: printClientList
methods.description: Generates a PDF file containing a list of clients with specified attributes.

methods.name: makeTablePdf
methods.description: Creates a PDF document with a table populated from a list of data rows.

methods.name: printContract
methods.description: Generates a PDF document representing a contract, including client and company details, and a test message.
